metadata.description: Combined inventory of ALL known snow point-observation stations (SWE and/or snow depth) from AWDB (US + partner networks), CDEC (California), DataBC (BC, Canada), NVE (Norway), Yukon AquaCache, Hydro-Québec (Québec; CC BY-NC 4.0, non-commercial), Alberta River Basins, SLF (Switzerland), SNIH (Argentina) and CEAZA-Met (Chile) — including periodic snow courses and other manual sites. daily_or_better marks stations with a (probe-verified, see daily_verified) daily-or-better record; the CSV archive and live map cover exactly those. The same physical site may appear once per access path — see possible_duplicates. Schema: DESIGN.md §6.1.

properties.name: Canyon Lake Snow Course
properties.operator: Yukon Government Department of Environment, Water Science and Stewardship

data_variables.name: swe_mm
data_variables.description: Snow water equivalent. At automated snow-weather stations this comes from a snow pillow recorded hourly to 3-hourly; at snow courses it is the average of a 10-point manual survey. Native API unit is mm; returned here in cm (÷ 10).
data_variables.notes: Native units: mm. Snow course values carry a flag of 'Actual' (measured depth and SWE) or 'Estimated SWE' (measured depth with SWE estimated from historical average density).

data_variables.name: snwd_cm
data_variables.description: Snow depth from an automated sensor (Yukon and ECCC stations) or from a 10-point manual snow course survey. Native API unit is cm.
data_variables.notes: Native units: cm. NB: /snow-survey/data leaves the units field empty for this parameter; cm is confirmed by the /snow-survey/stats field name 'max_DEPTH_cm'.

properties.notes: Hydro-Québec open data, CC BY-NC 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/): attribution required, no commercial use. The feed keeps only a rolling ~10-day window, so this archive's CSV is the accumulated record from the first nightly refresh on; GMON history before that is in CanSWE (HQ- stations).

data_variables.name: Humidité relative.2 mètres
data_variables.description: Relative humidity at 2 m, hourly instantaneous.
data_variables.notes: Daily = mean over the local day. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

data_variables.name: Précipitation
data_variables.description: Hourly total precipitation (rain and snow water).
data_variables.notes: Hourly sums; daily = sum over the local day (needs >= 20 valid hours). Negative values are nulled. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

data_variables.name: Température Maximum
data_variables.description: Hourly maximum air temperature.
data_variables.notes: Daily = max of hourly maxima over the local day. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

data_variables.name: Température Minimum
data_variables.description: Hourly minimum air temperature.
data_variables.notes: Daily = min of hourly minima over the local day. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

data_variables.name: Épaisseur de neige
data_variables.description: Depth of snow on the ground, hourly instantaneous.
data_variables.notes: Native cm. Sensor type not stated by Hydro-Québec (the portal says GMON measures both depth and SWE). Negative near-zero noise is nulled. Daily = last valid value of the local day. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

data_variables.name: Équivalent en eau de la neige
data_variables.description: Snow water equivalent from a GMON passive gamma sensor.
data_variables.notes: Native mm, returned in cm. Published hourly but the GMON value changes only every 6 h (~01/07/13/19 UTC); hours in between repeat the last reading. Daily = last valid value of the America/Toronto local day. Early-season GMON readings can be spurious when the ground is bare. Rolling ~10-day window only. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

The feed keeps only a rolling ~10-day window, so this archive's CSV is the accumulated record from the first nightly refresh on; GMON history before that is in CanSWE (HQ- stations).

data_variables.name: Humidité relative.2 mètres
data_variables.description: Relative humidity at 2 m, hourly instantaneous.
data_variables.notes: Daily = mean over the local day. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

data_variables.name: Précipitation
data_variables.description: Hourly total precipitation (rain and snow water).
data_variables.notes: Hourly sums; daily = sum over the local day (needs >= 20 valid hours). Negative values are nulled. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

data_variables.name: Température Maximum
data_variables.description: Hourly maximum air temperature.
data_variables.notes: Daily = max of hourly maxima over the local day. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

data_variables.name: Température Minimum
data_variables.description: Hourly minimum air temperature.
data_variables.notes: Daily = min of hourly minima over the local day. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

data_variables.name: Épaisseur de neige
data_variables.description: Depth of snow on the ground, hourly instantaneous.
data_variables.notes: Native cm. Sensor type not stated by Hydro-Québec (the portal says GMON measures both depth and SWE). Negative near-zero noise is nulled. Daily = last valid value of the local day. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

data_variables.name: Équivalent en eau de la neige
data_variables.description: Snow water equivalent from a GMON passive gamma sensor.
data_variables.notes: Native mm, returned in cm. Published hourly but the GMON value changes only every 6 h (~01/07/13/19 UTC); hours in between repeat the last reading. Daily = last valid value of the America/Toronto local day. Early-season GMON readings can be spurious when the ground is bare. Rolling ~10-day window only. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

data_variables.notes: Native mm, returned in cm. Published hourly but the GMON value changes only every 6 h (~01/07/13/19 UTC); hours in between repeat the last reading. data_variables.notes: Hourly sums; daily = sum over the local day (needs >= 20 valid hours). Negative values are nulled. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

data_variables.name: Température Maximum
data_variables.description: Hourly maximum air temperature.
data_variables.notes: Daily = max of hourly maxima over the local day. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

data_variables.name: Température Minimum
data_variables.description: Hourly minimum air temperature.
data_variables.notes: Daily = min of hourly minima over the local day. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

data_variables.name: Vitesse du vent.10 mètres
data_variables.description: Hourly mean wind speed at 10 m.
data_variables.notes: Daily = mean over the local day. The portal text mentions 2.5 m wind, but only 10 m series are present in the feed. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

data_variables.name: Épaisseur de neige
data_variables.description: Depth of snow on the ground, hourly instantaneous.

properties.operator: Centro de Estudios Avanzados en Zonas Áridas (CEAZA)
properties.data_provider: CEAZA-Met (Datos provistos por el laboratorio de meteorología CEAZA)
properties.notes: Datos provistos por el laboratorio de meteorología CEAZA (https://www.ceazamet.cl/). No licence is stated; the terms of use ask users to register a user name and to credit the source with a link. Raw logger output, not quality controlled.

data_variables.name: ta_c:HDCTA
data_variables.description: Air temperature; value is the interval mean.
data_variables.notes: value_min / value_max are the interval extremes. Values outside −60 to 50 °C are nulled. Sensor HDCTA at 2.0 m; daily = the service's mean over the UTC−4 day.

data_variables.name: ani_cm:HDCAN
data_variables.description: Snow depth from an automatic snow-depth sensor.
data_variables.notes: Raw logger values. Bare ground often reads slightly negative (zero offset); those values are nulled by the 0–15 m bound, not set to zero. El Tapado has two sensors (TPFSNOWD to 2023, TPFANSHM31 from 2018). Sensor HDCAN at 2.85 m; daily = the service's mean over the UTC−4 day.

data_variables.name: pnkg:HDCPN
data_variables.description: Snow weight per unit area (Guandacol HDCPN, Llano de Las Liebres LLLSW1Wins1h and LLLSW2Wins1h), i.e. SWE: 1 kg/m² = 1 mm of water.
data_variables.notes: Published in kg/m²; returned as SWE in cm (× 0.1). The two Llano de Las Liebres sensors disagree: on days when either reads over 10 kg/m² the median difference is 32 kg/m² and the largest 182 kg/m² (2024-08-02). Sensor HDCPN at 0.0 m; daily = the service's mean over the UTC−4 day.
